title: Minimax Treatment Choice for Extreme CVaR in the Marked Rare-Event Limit
banked_reason: The promised all-intensity marked minimax result—frontier, attaining rule, and least-favorable severity support—remains an open question; the core instead delivers a low-intensity phase and a certified approximation route.
gap_reasons: The promised all-intensity marked minimax result—frontier, attaining rule, and least-favorable severity support—remains an open question; the core instead delivers a low-intensity phase and a certified approximation route.
These omissions leave a technically substantial companion note rather than a field-level resolution.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 proved the low-intensity equality, mixed-orbit obstruction, certified finite-game approximation, finite-trial transfer, binary asymptotic constant, and matching square-root marked minimax rate. D0.5 accepted the mathematics but found the promised all-intensity frontier, attaining rule, and least-favorable severity support unresolved. At lambda=2, the exact three-type game lies below the binary benchmark, and no candidate strict-gap prior with a positive certified margin was found; the field floor was therefore not met.
tldr: On the valid trial domain \(n\ge\lceil2\lambda\rceil\), a balanced trial with tail level \(\lambda/n\) converges to two independent marked-Poisson observations, and the terminal causal choice loss is governed by the top unit of adverse severity. The proved results give an exact low-intensity minimax phase, an independently checkable rational mixed-orbit instance, convergent certified finite-game approximation bounds with measurable data-only rules, a finite-trial transfer, and the matching high-intensity minimax rate \(R(\lambda)=\Theta(\lambda^{-1/2})\). The binary lower anchor has sharp constant \(\kappa_{\mathrm{bin}}=0.3399424149\ldots\), while the exact all-intensity frontier, its least-favorable severity geometry, and the sharp marked constant remain open.
gap: Published work separately treats fixed-confidence CVaR arm identification, rare-event compound-Poisson approximation, fixed-tail causal policy welfare, Gaussian minimax treatment games, and finite-sample minimax treatment choice for a fixed quantile. It does not determine the fixed-exposure marked-Poisson terminal regret when the lower-tail CVaR fraction shrinks as \(\lambda/n\).
fill: The project combines finite-prior Bayes duality with outward-certified marked games to settle the binary-equality versus strict-gap dichotomy, constructs a measurable attaining rule, transfers it to the finite randomized trial on \(n\ge\lceil2\lambda\rceil\), and derives the high-intensity local constant.
